title: Mission:

ytTitle: Mission: Algorithm - plan your program, start with the end (IT song)
desc:
Every program is a mission. Before you write a line of code, know what it must produce - then plan your way there.

In this song:
- Start with the end: know the output you want first
- Then plan Input, Processing, Output (IPO)

title: Let the
*Database*
Do the Work
ytTitle: Let the Database Do the Work - SQL WHERE for your PAT (IT song)
desc:
Why loop through every record in your PAT when SQL can do it for you? Filter at the source with WHERE and let the database do the work.

In this song:
- Don't pull every record into your program
- Use WHERE to fetch only the rows you need
- A tuck-shop PAT example: 3 drinks out of 14, straight from the query

Goes with the PAT and database lessons in the Pascal, Java and SQL courses at https://bestlessons.co.za
